about.title: About NAACUS
about.intro: The National Association of African Catholics in the United States (NAACUS) brings together African Catholics and their families to foster faith, leadership, and service in the Church across the United States. Rooted in the Gospel and our motto "Together with Christ," we welcome members into an active community for fellowship, workshops, and collaborative ministries.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.description: To gather African Catholic communities in the U.S., promote their faith, and ensure their full and active participation in the life of the Church.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.description: A vibrant and visible African Catholic community that contributes its gifts to the Church and society—confident in identity, generous in service, and engaged in society.

motto.title: Our Motto
motto.description: "Together with Christ" — We build welcoming networks of fellowship, workshops, and community initiatives that uplift people, celebrate culture, and advance the common good.

memberBenefits.title: Become a Member of NAACUS
memberBenefits.subtitle: Join a thriving community of African Catholics united in faith, culture, and service across the United States.

community.title: Vibrant Community
community.description: Connect with thousands of African Catholic families and individuals who share your faith and heritage.

events.title: Exclusive Events
events.description: Access to national conferences, workshops, cultural celebrations, and spiritual retreats throughout the year.

resources.title: Faith Resources
resources.description: Get access to prayer materials, catechetical resources, newsletters, and spiritual formation programs.

spiritual.title: Spiritual Growth
spiritual.description: Deepen your faith through Bible studies, prayer groups, and opportunities to serve in various ministries.

network.title: National Network
network.description: Build relationships with African Catholic communities across all 50 states and strengthen the Church.

leadership.title: Leadership Development
leadership.description: Develop your gifts through leadership training, mentorship programs, and opportunities to serve.

testimonials.title: What Our Members Say
testimonials.subtitle: Hear from members who have found community, faith, and purpose through NAACUS.

testimonial1.text: NAACUS has been a blessing to my family. We found a welcoming community where we can celebrate our African heritage while growing in our Catholic faith. The annual conferences are transformative!
testimonial1.author: Mary Okonkwo

testimonial2.text: As a young professional, NAACUS connected me with mentors and friends who share my values. The leadership programs have helped me serve my parish and community with confidence.
testimonial2.author: Joseph Kamara

testimonial3.text: Finding NAACUS was like finding home. The community embraces our African traditions while deepening our Catholic identity. I'm grateful for the spiritual support and lasting friendships.
testimonial3.author: Amara Nwosu
